entities.name: Saint Nicholas Rotunda Church in Cieszyn
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Rotunda of Saint Nicolas in Cieszyn is a Romanesque rotunda located in the town of Cieszyn, Poland. The structure was built in the 11th or the 12th century as a Western Christian castle chapel and stronghold (gord) church.
